```suggestion
				bool is_class_name = (!content.is_empty() && content != "url" && !content.contains_char(' ') && !content.contains_char('=') && !content.contains_char('/'));
```
I'd say `contains_char` is cleaner when we don't need a specific starting position, also this reorder should be more optimal as it does faster checks first, checking that a character doesn't exist is `O(N)` and checking non-empty and non-equality with `"url"` should both be `O(1)` (practically around 4 steps for the equality check)
